description: This file is a shell script for testing Git clone operations with various configurations, including references, alternates, and symlinks. It sets up repositories, performs clones, and validates object counts and filesystem states to verify Git's behavior in advanced cloning scenarios.

methods.name: commit_in
methods.description: Creates a commit in the specified repository with the given filename and content.

methods.name: test_objcount
methods.description: Checks the number of loose objects in the repository matches the expected count.
